notes.title: 🔥Achievements & Leaderboards in Pollen: New Ways to Shine!🔥
notes.content:
Dear players,

The world of Pollen just got even more exciting! We’re introducing two major updates to enhance your experience:

[b]Achievements:[/b]
Unlock 15 unique achievements as you progress through the game. Whether you’re mastering stealthy escapes, completing levels at record speed, or showing sheer persistence, there’s an achievement waiting for you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45082956/8ee101d71f383073d55a776e42d5a7f2667d717d.jpg[/img]

[b]Leaderboards:[/b]
Think you’re the fastest? Prove it! Each level now features a leaderboard where players can compete for the best completion times. Compare your results with friends and the global community to see who’s truly the ultimate player.


What’s new for you?

Dynamic Challenges: Achievements tailored to every playstyle and strategy.

Global Recognition: Leaderboards to showcase your best times and compare with players worldwide.

The update is live, so jump into Pollen, unlock those achievements, and set unbeatable records on the leaderboards.

The spotlight is yours — let the competition begin! 🌟

notes.title: Introducing the New Beginner-Friendly Level!
notes.content:
Embark on your gaming journey with confidence! 
We're excited to introduce a new game level tailored specifically for new and beginner players. 
This level strikes the perfect balance between fun and learning, providing a gentle introduction to the game mechanics without overwhelming you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45082956/70866a80c4c6e1a825b9ddb8a5f88a4767468dec.png[/img]
Key Features:
Simplified Challenges: Designed to familiarize you with gameplay basics.
Achievable Goals: Set up to boost your confidence and prepare you for the complexities of higher levels.

Whether you're picking up Pollen for the first time or just need a refresher, this level will ensure you're well-equipped to tackle the more demanding stages that await. Start play now and transform from a beginner to a pro, one level at a time!

notes.title: New Updates Coming to Pollen!
notes.content:
Dear Players,

We have started working on an achievements system, which will include more than 10 achievements, featuring secret and unique challenges for you to uncover and complete. Achievements will add more fun and replayability to your experience.

Additionally, we’re implementing a scoreboard system to let you track and compare your progress with other players. Whether you’re competing with friends or aiming for global recognition, the scoreboard will bring out your competitive spirit.

We’ve also begun development on a new starting level, designed for players who want an easier entry point to the game. This introductory level will offer a smoother learning curve, helping new players get ready for the more challenging labyrinths ahead.

Our team is hard at work, and we’re looking forward to bringing these updates to you in the next upcoming patches. Stay tuned for more details and release dates!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45082956/2adfdc5be80a7e6151885263d4c37c37c62a1f48.png[/img]

Thank you for your support and feedback.

With gratitude,
The FSTR Team

notes.title: QoL Update
notes.content:
Hey players!

We’ve rolled out a little Quality of Life update to make your escape experience smoother:

🔸 Pause Menu Upgrade – Now you can check the game rules and control keys directly from the pause menu. No more guessing on the run!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45082956/406bb65b41f488ed852ca7352e35cb492577870a.png[/img]


🔸 Exit Zone Hints – Added subtle visual cues to guide you toward the level’s exit. Escaping the maze just got a tiny bit easier. ([i]By the way, check out our personal record for completing the first level—it’s in the top-right corner of the screenshot. Can anyone beat it?[/i])
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45082956/182aeeded3cbc4d7ceb4dcab11c29c8d356b048c.png[/img]


Let us know what you think, and happy escaping! 🌀

– The FSTR Team
